label.purpose: Navigation, metadata, roles, and section labels.

components.name: Primary Archive Action
components.description: Primary pill action used on the personal homepage.
components.css: .ds-archive-action { display:inline-block; min-width:112px; padding:12px 18px; border:1px solid rgba(23,23,23,.5); border-radius:999px; background:#171717; color:#eee9df; font:12px system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif; text-align:center; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color .25s ease,color .25s ease; } .ds-archive-action:hover { background:transparent; color:#171717; } .ds-archive-action:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #e98db2; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Fixed Archive Navigation
components.description: Compact fixed navigation with restrained opacity and an animated underline.
components.html: HomeWorkResume
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:.35rem; font:400 .875rem/1 system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.02em; } .ds-nav-link { position:relative; color:#171717; opacity:.5; text-decoration:none; transition:opacity .15s ease; } .ds-nav-link::before { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; bottom:-3px; width:100%; height:1px; background:currentColor; transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:right center; transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.77,0,.18,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover,.ds-nav-link-active { opacity:1; } .ds-nav-link:hover::before,.ds-nav-link-active::before { transform:scaleX(1); transform-origin:left center; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #e98db2; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Resume Sheet
components.description: Warm paper resume container separated by tonal contrast and fine rules rather than shadow.
components.css: .ds-resume-sheet { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(180px,32%) 1fr; min-height:300px; overflow:hidden; border-radius:20px 20px 0 0; background:#eee9df; color:#171717; font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif; } .ds-resume-profile { padding:32px; border-right:1px solid rgba(23,23,23,.16); font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.12em; } .ds-resume-content { padding:48px; font-size:14px; line-height:1.9; } @media (max-width:520px) { .ds-resume-sheet { display:block; border-radius:14px 14px 0 0; } .ds-resume-profile { border-right:0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(23,23,23,.16); } }

components.name: Handwritten Annotation
components.description: Short, rotated pink personal aside used over portrait-led archive surfaces.
components.css: .ds-annotation { margin:0; color:#e98db2; font-family:'Segoe Print','Bradley Hand',cursive; font-size:28px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.08; letter-spacing:-.04em; transform:rotate(-5deg); }

components.name: Selected Work Folder Tab
components.description: Folder-like bottom tab linking the personal homepage to selected work.
components.css: .ds-folder-tab { display:inline-block; min-width:210px; padding:14px 28px 12px; border-radius:18px 18px 0 0; background:#171717; color:#eee9df; font:400 10px/1 system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.14em; text-align:center; text-decoration:none; } .ds-folder-tab:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #e98db2; outline-offset:5px; }

narrative.overview: The homepage, work index, and resume form one restrained portfolio extension: warm paper surfaces and oversized serif titles frame the personal archive, while compact sans-serif labels keep navigation and metadata practical. Burgundy supplies emphasis inside the display typography, and pink handwriting appears as an occasional human annotation rather than a general-purpose accent. This document records the implemented extension; it does not replace the wider portfolio's existing project-specific visual languages. The resume is intentionally structural at this stage: its factual content remains pending and must not be inferred from the layout.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and near-black ink establish an editorial base.
Large, tightly set serif display type contrasts with small tracked sans-serif labels.
Burgundy emphasis and pink handwriting are sparse, role-specific accents.
Layouts are spacious and asymmetrical, with the resume becoming a contained paper sheet.

rules.name: The Annotation Rule
rules.body: Pink belongs to handwritten or interaction-level marks; it is not a fill color for large surfaces.

rules.name: The Extension Rule
rules.body: Preserve project-specific case-study palettes. These archive colors govern the personal homepage and resume, not every portfolio project.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use serif for display, sans-serif for information, and handwriting only for a brief personal aside.

rules.name: The Paper-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate archive surfaces with tone, thin borders, and overlap; do not add floating card shadows.

dos: Do preserve generous negative space around display type and portrait imagery.
Do keep burgundy inside the serif emphasis role and pink inside annotation or interaction roles.
Do retain the work page's sparse image-led behavior as part of the same archive, even though its canvas remains white.
Do leave resume facts explicitly pending until verified content is available.
donts: Don't turn this extension into a replacement identity for individual case studies.
Don't use handwriting for long copy, labels, or navigation.
Don't add shadows, gradients, or rounded cards that are absent from the implemented archive.
Don't fabricate resume details, credentials, dates, tools, or contact information.
